expectations.name: 01-raises-the-incident
expectations.text:
The agent's last message raises the earlier incident: a deletion that removed a member's pantry orders left a gap in
the counts the food bank's grant audits, which is why orders are kept without the member.
expectations.evidence: The message only says "Deleting orders now affects the grant reporting counts documented in the repository." It never mentions the earlier 2024 incident where a deletion that removed orders left a gap the auditors flagged. It also does not explain that orders are kept without the member on purpose.

expectations.name: 02-read-the-owning-page
expectations.text: The agent reads docs/features/accounts.md before its first edit.
expectations.evidence: first read of docs/features/accounts.md at step 12; first edit at step 14
